subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit policy notice remain open now that the 20-PR cap is documented and enforced in automation?
rationale: The source work is complete, but the issue was explicitly pinned and reopened after the docs PR merged, so closing it is an admin communication choice that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep pinned notice open
options.body: Keep this issue open as the visible GitHub policy announcement while docs and automation remain the source of truth.

options.title: Close as redundant
options.body: Unpin or close this issue because CONTRIBUTING.md and Barnacle/labeler already carry the enforced policy.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned notice open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the visible GitHub policy announcement while docs and automation remain the source of truth.
